annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2025/2653 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 19 December 2025 amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, (EU) 2021/695, (EU) 2021/697, (EU) 2021/1153 and (EU) 2024/795, as regards incentivising defence-related investment in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2025/2653 amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, 2021/695, 2021/697, 2021/1153 and 2024/795 as regards incentivising defence-related investment in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU regulation amending five funding regulations (Digital Europe, Horizon Europe, European Defence Fund, Connecting Europe Facility, STEP) to boost defence and dual-use investment under ReArm Europe. It adds a defence strategic sector to STEP, funds AI Gigafactories, and sets eligibility restrictions. It has only incidental embodied-AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds a fourth STEP strategic sector for defence technologies.
Opens the EIC Accelerator to dual-use and critical defence technologies, derogating from Horizon Europe's civil-only focus.
Restricts participation to entities in the EU, Ukraine or EEA associated states, excluding third-country-controlled entities unless guarantees are given.
Associates Ukraine with the European Defence Fund and allows voluntary contributions and transfers.
Extends Digital Europe and CEF to AI Factories and AI Gigafactories and to military-mobility dual-use infrastructure.
